interpretation_basis: NASA PGDA product 78 publishes 100 Site01 clones. Barker et al. (2021) describe constructing a Z-error map for each realization and adding that Z-error map back to the LDEM to form a clone; the ensemble has approximately the same error properties as the data.
non_claims: The direct clone filenames/URLs identify published sources but do not establish source-byte identity until acquisition computes exact SHA-256 values.
The 100-member ensemble is finite statistical evidence, not a deterministic upper bound on all physically possible terrain.
Clone evidence does not by itself close unresolved terrain between raster support points.
